articleTitle: Apple Eyes 2029 AI Server With M‑Series Ultra Chips

sources.title: Apple reportedly building server packed with M-series Ultra chips for AI

claims.claim: Apple has been absent from the enterprise server market for decades, and the planned 2029 server could be its first enterprise server in decades.
